== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes use this skill on an ally as soon as that ally has been inflicted with at least one hex or condition. They will not reserve use of Peace and Harmony to remove multiple hexes and conditions.

== Notes ==
* This skill alternates removing conditions and hexes, starting with a condition.
* A target enchanted with Peace and Harmony is at a disadvantage when being targeted by [[End effect#Skills with end effects that do not trigger if it is removed|hexes with end effects that do not trigger if it is removed]], since Peace and Harmony will cause their end effect to trigger earlier whereas [[List of hex removal skills|removing the hex]] does not cause it to trigger. Similarly, they will cause conditions to expire faster, triggering [[Fragility]] more often.
{{bug|Contrary to the description, Peace and Harmony doesn't cause conditions and hexes to expire 90% faster. Instead, all '''new''' conditions and hexes, applied during the enchantment, will have their duration '''reduced''' by 90%.}}
